title: Fragment
summary: FRAG'MENT, noun [Latin fragmentum, from frango, to break.] 1. A part broken off; a piece separated from any thing by breaking. Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing is lost. John 6:12. 2.

inlines.v: FRAG'MENT, noun [Latin fragmentum, from frango, to break.] 1. A part broken off; a piece separated from any thing by breaking. Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing is lost. John 6:12. 2. A part separated from the rest; an imperfect part; as fragments of ancient writings. 3. A small detached portion; as fragments of time.
